parsed.rationale: All three type aliases — `PlaybackBlendModeKey`, `MaterialBlendModeKey`, and `OverlayBlendModeKey` — are structurally identical (`kind: type-alias-object`, `fields_or_signature: []`, `line: 89`) and live in the same package (`Wallpaper`) under `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/`. No restraint markers are set on any record. Because they are exact duplicates within the same package, a single shared type alias `BlendModeKey` can be declared once in the `Wallpaper` package (e.g., in a new `BlendModeKey.swift` or an existing shared core file) and the three per-mode redeclarations removed. Each call site can either use `BlendModeKey` directly or introduce a `typealias PlaybackBlendModeKey = BlendModeKey` at the point of use if distinct nominal identity is still desired.
